clips.title: The story
paras: In Tarren Mill, Umpi endures Apothecary Lydon's experiments. The frog is kept in the Royal Apothecary Society's workshop as a test subject for toxins and plague brews.

Umpi is a frog in Tarren Mill who bears the cost of Apothecary Lydon's experiments. For Lydon, testing his formulas requires living flesh, and he gives Umpi lethal brews such as the Elixir of Suffering and the Elixir of Agony. The poisons kill her, but Lydon re-animates her so she can face another dose for the Royal Apothecary Society.
